description: This file defines the GraphingSettingsViewModel class, which manages the state and properties related to graphing settings in a calculator application, including axis ranges, error states, and trigonometric mode settings. It includes property change notifications and interactions with a Grapher object.

classes.name: GraphingSettingsViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class that manages graphing settings such as axis ranges, error states, and trig modes for a calculator's graphing component.

methods.name: UpdateDisplayRange
methods.description: Updates the display range of the graph based on current axis min/max values.

methods.name: SetGrapher
methods.description: Associates a Grapher object with this ViewModel.

methods.name: ResetView
methods.description: Resets the view to default settings.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Checks if there are any errors in the current settings.
